counterparty_name.description: The party that SENT the notice (or, for an outbound notice, its recipient). Legal entity name as written.

counterparty_ref.description: The sender's own reference/file number for this notice, if printed on it.

subject.description: A short factual title, under 120 characters.

notice_date.description: Date printed on the notice, as YYYY-MM-DD.

deadline.description: The notice's own wording of the response deadline. Copy it; never compute a date.

stated.description: True only when the notice itself writes a deadline (a date or a period). False when none is written or one would come only from a statute or custom.

explicit_date.description: A calendar date the notice writes out as the deadline, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null when it gives a period.

clear_days.description: True only when the notice says the days are clear days.

runs_from_text.description: What the period runs from, in the notice's words.

quote.description: The sentence that states the deadline.

demanded_action.description: One or two sentences: what the notice demands, and by when.

confidence.description: 0.0-1.0 — how confident you are overall. Be honest; low for a scanned or partial document.
